description: Single blog article layout: title + meta + cover image + prose content + tags. Pass HTML content via contentHtml prop, OR use the default slot with regular Astro markup. Built-in lp-prose typography styles handle h2/h3/blockquote/code/img/list.

category.hint: Single primary category. Renders as Tag chip.

tags.hint: 3-6 tags. Render at the bottom as a tag list.

cover.hint: Hero image. 16:9 or wider works best. Caption renders below.

contentHtml.hint: Pre-rendered HTML content. If set, used in place of the default slot and sanitized against the editorial allowlist before rendering.

preview.title: How we shipped a 16-section component library in one afternoon
preview.excerpt: Three principles for letting an AI assemble production sites without DEMO-feel.
